title: bumelia neglecta
intro: Bumelia neglecta, commonly known as the false buckthorn or Texas buckthorn, is a shrub or small tree species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bumelia neglecta include wound healing, immune system support, and the management of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
